_comment: This week's tango plan: which nights are class / practica / milonga / solo, and the focus for each. tango-coach sets this at the weekly review; both skills read it at check-in. Days are placeholders until Patryk's real schedule is captured at intake.

tuesday.focus: SOLO 90min: free leg→boleos (front+back), sequences (his list, shadow-lead), musicality 15-min routine. PRACTICA 2h: take boleos + sequences to a partner, end in connection/joy.

thursday.focus: UNCERTAIN day. If solo: ~20-25min light — keep the free-leg/boleo groove warm + 10min musicality. Don't pile load before Friday. If practica: take boleos + sequences, refine (don't introduce new).
thursday.note: Deliberately light to protect Friday's practica+milonga.

friday.focus: PRACTICA: refine boleos (front+back) + sequences, end in flowing tandas. MILONGA: NO drilling — dance for joy/connection, boleos only if floor genuinely open. Milonga strategy = tango-coach.
friday.note: Heavy day (practica then milonga). Keep Wed/Thu light.

sunday.focus: set next week's 1-3 active topics, review the week's dancing

_slot_options: class | practica | milonga | solo | rest | weekly_review
